trigger: The owner explicitly rejected A+ V1 as still not visually attractive enough.
rejectionMeaning: A+ V1 remains valid only as failure evidence for hierarchy, data completeness, and technical checks. It is not an accepted visual reference and must not be incrementally polished into production.
taskMeaning: Create one materially different high-fidelity art direction with stronger commercial composition, fixed provisional Airburg tokens, clear material contrast, and complete metric honesty.
prototypeStrategy: Use an isolated standalone HTML prototype inside this task folder for exact palette, typography, material, and 1440 composition. Do not use the theme-adaptive inline renderer as the source of visual truth.
forbiddenActions: Modify production app, components, lib, types, package, deployment, or route files
Modify formulas, metric semantics, ETL, persistence, adapters, PROJECT_SSOT.json, or current-task.json
Treat the standalone prototype as production implementation
Set visualAccepted, humanAccepted, or commercialReady to true
Deploy, push, commit, or redirect any production route
validationConclusion: The isolated prototype passed the scoped automated visual-contract and runtime checks. This does not equal owner aesthetic acceptance, production parity, or commercial readiness.
stopRule: Stop after a validated isolated prototype and human-review handoff. Production implementation requires a separate explicit authorization.
